card.name: The digit 2 starting a number
card.fires_on: The digit 2 as the first digit of a two-digit number, especially needle gauge ranges like 21G to 23G. Also fires on 'New' in 'The New York Times'.

modes.label: Leading 2 in a number
modes.description: The digit 2 begins a two-digit number such as 23, 25 or 26, often in a range of needle gauges.
modes.example: using a syringe with a 21- to <<2>>5-gauge needle

modes.label: New in New York Times
modes.description: The word New in a citation of The New York Times, just before York.

card.plain: It lights up when a number starts with 2 and the next digit is still to come, as in needle sizes, and on 'New' before York Times.
